parsed.claim_reason: Nonincreasing means later terms may be smaller than q_1. Positivity only requires q_k>0, so it does not prevent a term from equaling or falling below 1.
parsed.witness_reason: Every term is positive, q_1=2>1, and 2>=1>=1>=... confirms the sequence is nonincreasing. Yet q_2=1 is not greater than 1, violating the conclusion.
